title: Constructibility and a fixed interval in one successor reduction
statement: Let $X$ be Noetherian, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, and $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ with the continuous coefficients and derived reductions of [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. Put $L_j=K\otimes^{\mathbf L}\mathcal O_E/\pi_E^{j+1}$ for $j\ge0$. For any $n\ge0$ and integers $a,b$, suppose $L_0$ and $L_n$ are bounded constructible in the finite-constant-model sense [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and both have zero cohomology in every degree $q<a$ or $q>b$. Then $L_{n+1}$ is bounded constructible and has zero cohomology in all those same degrees. There is no completeness or Tor-amplitude hypothesis on $K$, and no assumption $a\le b$ is needed. Use the unbounded module-sheaf derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text: Choose the simultaneous flat-term K-flat representative from the strict DVR reduction theorem. Its residue-kernel sequence has first term the residue reduction, middle term the successor reduction, and last term the preceding reduction. The completed projection is surjective on sections: lift a finite quotient section to a constant integral section and then to the completion. Full faithful scalar restriction therefore lifts this short exact sequence to complexes over the successor quotient. Restriction composition identifies the outer complexes with the appropriate restricted finite reductions.

theorem successiveReduction_constructible_interval (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (K : DerivedCategory (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X))
    (n : ℕ) (a b : ℤ)
    (hfirst : constantModelBoundedConstructible (DerivedNakayama.quotientRing l E 1) X
      ((AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X 0).obj K))
    (hprev : constantModelBoundedConstructible (DerivedNakayama.quotientRing l E (n + 1)) X
      ((AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X n).obj K))
    (hfirstBounds : ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X 0).obj K)))
    (hprevBounds : ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X n).obj K))) :
    constantModelBoundedConstructible (DerivedNakayama.quotientRing l E (n + 1 + 1)) X
        ((AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X (n + 1)).obj K) ∧
      ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
          ((AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X (n + 1)).obj K))
